info.title: Gym Tracker Log
info.description: Reads and updates the user's workout log, stored as gym-tracker-backup.json in a GitHub Gist.

get.summary: Get the user's full workout log
get.description: Returns the gist object. The log is the JSON string in files['gym-tracker-backup.json'].content: sessions keyed by ISO date, each with a day type and per-exercise arrays of sets {r: reps, kg: weight-or-null-for-bodyweight}, plus customEx definitions for non-built-in exercises.

200.description: The gist containing the workout log

patch.summary: Overwrite the workout log with updated content
patch.description: Replaces gym-tracker-backup.json with the complete updated log JSON. Always call getWorkoutLog immediately before, modify minimally, and send back the FULL document — every existing session, override, and customEx entry must be preserved.

content.description: The complete new log as a JSON string
